quote: To better understand how MixGR enhances downstream QA tasks, we implement the retrieval-then-read approach on two datasets SciQ and SciFact. ... Specifically, we utilize LLama-3-8B-Instruct as the reader model.
We assess the performance by measuring the Exact Match (EM) rate
We assess the performance by measuring the Exact Match (EM) rate—the proportion of responses where the predicted answer perfectly aligns with the reference answer, denoted as EM@k.
